page.notes: Running head "DE HOMINIS GRATITVD." transcribed with V as U. Page number 799 at top right. Catchword "Negatio" at bottom right. The first line is a fragment ("mum ius"), probably the end of "summum ius", and is kept as printed. Doubtful readings: "Duritics" [unclear, possibly Duritiēs]; "stricti" is printed with a long-s-like form and may need checking. "Nemesi" has an ornate initial N. Stray marks before "Humanitati" and "Cū" are printer's marks and are not text. The paragraph beginning "Cū Amicitia" continues on the next page.
